inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped MySQL query applies STDDEV_POP to numeric rows for a report bucket.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored regression with one grouped value set. It isolates the STDDEV_POP aggregate name and result metadata without the original time expressions or nested daily aggregate.

fixture_notes: Bucket 4 contains values 10 and 14, so MariaDB returns a population spread of 2. The single group isolates STDDEV_POP support.
determinism_notes: The query orders by the unique bucket value; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_spread (bucket INT NOT NULL, reading DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT bucket, STDDEV_POP(reading) AS spread FROM mini_spread GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
